description: Source code implementing proxy configuration logic for network proxy resolution, including classes and functions for managing proxy rules, parsing proxy strings, and applying proxy settings based on URLs.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Represents network proxy configuration, including automatic and manual settings, and proxy rules.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules
classes.description: Encapsulates rules for proxy selection, including different proxy lists per scheme, fallback proxies, and bypass rules.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::Apply
methods.description: Applies proxy rules to a given URL, determining whether to use direct connection or a proxy list.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses a string defining proxy rules and populates the proxy rules data structures.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the proxy configuration into a JSON-like value for external use.
